description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters.
The IDs of the service instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest delete-service-instances --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-d6ab3a63ccbb4b170000 --region cn-hangzhou
